name: std::istrstream::~istrstream
intro: Destroys a std::istrstream object, which also destroys the member std::strstreambuf.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The constructors of std::istrstream do not create the underlying std::strstreambuf in dynamically allocated mode, so the memory leaks that are possible with std::ostrstream::~ostrstream or std::strstream::~strstream do not apply.

summary: Destroys a std::istrstream object, which also destroys the member std::strstreambuf.
